note: Expected results written by hand, not taken from the implementation. "cases" run on the rule table embedded here and follow the account update spec (COACTUPC section 8) and the rule table semantics. "shippedCases" run on the shipped rules.json; their expected values come from the account-service contract v4 field rules (ACUP, CRDL, CRDV, CRDU) and, for the account view (ACVW), from the COACTVWC spec items VAL-ACVW-001 and VAL-ACVW-002 as amended by the architect rulings on that contract (dates, limits, phone prefix, D-49 changed fields, D-51 card expiry), and for a stored NULL date in the cross-date entries, from the ruling on contract v5 (a NULL bound is left out; no check when the checked date or every bound is NULL). A case may give changedFields and stored (validate with changed fields, D-49). Run by FormRulesVectorsTest and rules.test.ts, together with lone-surrogate-vectors.json, which holds the cases with an unpaired surrogate. The strip cases follow Java's String.strip and stripTrailing (Character.isWhitespace), which the services apply; the latin1 cases follow the text repertoire rule: a free-text field accepts every character from U+0000 to U+00FF, the 256 a legacy byte holds, and refuses one above U+00FF with UNSUPPORTED_CHARACTER, checked on the stripped value after required and before maxLength. "textRules" (in "rules") pins the trim option, noSpace, codePoints (code points, a lone surrogate as one, ISO controls U+0000 to U+001F and U+007F to U+009F), differs with and without the legacyUpper fold, and inList on userTypes. The user-admin, sign-on and password-change shippedCases come from the server rules of identity-service as written (UserAdminService, UserIds, UserText, NewPasswords, SignOnService.authenticate and checkNewPassword, the catalogue texts): the first problem is the server's answer, except that the user ID length on sign-on and password change (INVALID_INPUT_USER_ID) is left to the server, and passwordChangeAnyMode keeps only the three blank checks.
